answer: A farm of 308 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in signal, queued in knoll, and nebula publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 33 identities per epoch. A farm of 1396 identities would post 1560 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
